description: Load an action set from an .aia file (Actions panel > Load Actions, or Replace Actions with replace: "all"). Before loading, the file can be edited: load the set under a new name, rename actions (Action Options), remove actions or steps, switch steps on or off (Toggle Item On/Off) and their dialogs (Toggle Dialog On/Off). Step numbers come from list_actions with filePath. The file on disk is not changed; saveAs writes the edited set to a new .aia file. Function keys and colours are not changed

actions.description: Edits to actions in the file, by name

enabled.description: Include the step in playback (Toggle Item On/Off)

showDialog.description: Stop at the step's dialog during playback (Toggle Dialog On/Off). Only for steps that have a dialog

load.description: Load it into Illustrator. Default true; false with saveAs only writes the file

replace.description: same_name (default): unload a loaded set with the same name first, so the panel does not get a second copy; all: unload every set first (Replace Actions); none: add alongside

saveAs.description: Also write the edited set to this .aia path

setName.description: Load the set under this name instead of the one in the file

name: load_actions
title: Load Actions
